settings.heading: Product Specifications
settings.content:
Vacuum Magnetic Suction: Securely mounts smartphones using a powerful magnetic block array and vacuum adsorption for exceptional holding strength—even on rough roads or uneven surfaces.

Universal Compatibility : Works with all smartphones, including non-magnetic devices, thanks to the included magnetic ring for secured grip, ensuring a seamless and versatile hands-free solution for any user.

Three-Axis Linkage & Multi-Faceted Adjustment: Features 360° bracket rotation and 180° flip options for the bracket and suction cup, allowing precise and flexible angle adjustment for optimal viewing and access in any position

Compact & Foldable Design: Easily folds into a portable form factor, making transport and storage convenient without any bulky components. Reliable mechanical vacuum lock fixes holder in place—no charging or adhesive required for operation, providing hassle-free installation and removal.

settings.heading: Product features
settings.content:
Easy Installation: Features a strong Vacuum suction base for mounting on dashboards, windshields, or flat surfaces without leaving any residue.

High Load-Bearing Capacity: Supports up to 5KG weight, ensuring phones, small tablets, or other devices are held firmly in place.

Sturdy Zinc Alloy Support Arm: High-quality support structure built from durable zinc alloy and alloy material for maximum stability and lasting use.

settings.heading: Materials and care
settings.content:
Materials: 

Made from premium-grade alloy (zinc alloy for the support arm, alloy+PC for body and parts) for durability, long-term use, and corrosion resistance.

Care Instructions:

  • Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust or fingerprints.
  • Avoid prolonged exposure to extreme heat or direct sunlight to prevent material degradation.
  • Ensure magnetic surfaces remain free of debris for optimal suction and grip.
  • Store folded and away from moisture when not in use for best longevity.
  • If needed, lightly clean with a damp cloth—do not immerse in water or use abrasive cleaners.
